title: Electroencephalogram in Patients With Friedreich's Ataxia for the Study of the Structural and Functional Connectome.
official: Structural-Functional Connectome and High Density Electroencephalogram: Pilot Study in Patients With Friedreich's Ataxia.
summary: Prospective, exploratory, multicenter pilot study investigating the structural and functional connectome in patients with Friedreich's Ataxia (FRDA) using high-density electroencephalogram (HD-EEG). The aim is to identify neurophysiological biomarkers and analyze the relationship between cortical connectivity, cognitive functioning, and clinical severity, particularly in response to rehabilitation treatment.

interventions.name: HD-EEG recordings, combined with cognitive and motor assessment
